dedupe_keys.name: xinlin li s radiation belt prediction model

description: The Li radiation-belt model predicts relativistic-electron behaviour using radial diffusion. Diffusion coefficients respond to solar-wind speed and magnetic-field measurements under specified boundary conditions. The resource is documented by CU Boulder; CU/LASP. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RadiationBelt; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree), Continuous/RT Run (ISWA layout). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. This formulation targets an electron environment, not spacecraft component damage directly. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
